changelog: Publish the reviewed Zhongcao Beauty Note Maker workflow with its English ClawHub listing.
summary: Create Xiaohongshu beauty and skincare content from product facts, routine steps, skin concerns, and audience context. This AI beauty note maker produces a 3:4 post concept, review structure, usage-scene copy, title options, cover wording, relevant hashtags, and a natural comment starter for makeup, skincare, haircare, body care, routines, comparisons, and product recommendations. Optionally it reads Xiaohongshu itself — the notes already running for the topic, one page of a note's top comments, and an account's own recent notes — so Xiaohongshu research, competitor note analysis and comment analysis rest on the platform instead of on guesswork.
